description.value: The Tipper is a cozy, casual neighbourhood restaurant in East Vancouver at Kingsway and Victoria Drive, describing itself as 'Cozy, Casual, Comforting' and doubling as a community gathering space that displays and sells work by local artists and craftspeople. The menu spans an all-day breakfast through to a lunch and dinner selection of sandwiches, burgers, and comfort food, with house-made sides and a rotating selection of specials. Touring cyclists will find a genuinely welcoming full-service meal stop on a major east–west corridor, with takeout available by phone.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and recently updated (references May Long Weekend 2026), confirming the business is open; the address (2066 Kingsway Vancouver B.C.) and phone (604.873.1010) both match OSM exactly, allowing contact_confirmed to be set true for all three fields. Takeout is explicitly confirmed on the menu page ('To order pick-up call 604.873.1010' and a dedicated Take-Out Tuesdays promotion); vegetarian and vegan options are confirmed by OSM diet tags and a menu reference to 'vegetarian poutine.' No evidence was found anywhere for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycle-specific infrastructure.
concerns: Website title is 'The Tipper Restaurant & Review Room', which differs slightly from the OSM name 'The Tipper'; the shorter form appears to be the accepted common name and is used throughout the site's navigation.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established neighbourhood restaurant with confirmed takeout and vegetarian/vegan menu options on a major cycling corridor in East Vancouver; a practical and welcoming food stop for touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page references 'Tipper's cheesy, vegetarian poutine' as a side option and lists multiple egg- and avocado-based breakfast items. GF not mentioned
